event.title: Add auto resolver for direct chat
event.body:
## Summary
- add messages.directChat auto resolver config shorthand/object support
- route ordinary direct messages through simple completion first
- delegate capability/tool work back into the normal OpenClaw agent resolver with a visible handoff acknowledgement

## Verification
- node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.visible-replies.test.ts src/config/schema.help.quality.test.ts src/agents/simple-completion-runtime.selection.test.ts
- pnpm tsgo:core --pretty false
- node scripts/build-all.mjs qaRuntime

## Deployment
- packed /tmp/openclaw-2026.5.30.tgz from qaRuntime build
- installed on raspberrypi
- restarted openclaw-gateway
- verified service active and messages.directChat=auto
